payload.claim: The module docstring says this script is unsafe beside a live task because 'its network takes the default subnet, as every task's does, so whichever starts second fails at create_network'. After this change a task's cells and critic networks no longer take the default subnet at all: they claim a /24 from the new pool (runtime.SUBNETS['pool'], 10.200.0.0/16) via allocate_network, so an ordinary task's own network can no longer collide with this script on that basis. The stated mechanism is now false, even though a collision with PACKAGE's re-verification (which still uses DEFAULT_SUBNET until SA-0271) may remain, so the warning gives the wrong reason for whatever risk still exists.
